input.explanation: No. The whole fault is inside this repository. In src/io_shop/spend_summary.py, `average_spend_per_item_this_month` divides by the number of purchases made this month. For any shopper who hasn't bought anything this month, that number is 0, so the function raises ZeroDivisionError. The fix adds a check in that same function and returns 0 in that case. It still returns an int, so `render_spend_summary` and src/io_shop/account_page.py, which calls it, work as they are. Once this is deployed, monthly-spend-feature can be turned back on without changing anything outside this repository. The flag is the only outside setting involved, and it needs no new behaviour.
